author: SummitVFX
quote: Massive budgets and flashy visuals can't replace actual soul and tight storytelling. Charging $79.99 at launch while gaming journalists throw 99s at it feels completely out of touch with real players. It's a decent sandbox, not the greatest game ever made rating it low to balance the inflated critic hype.

author: SummitVFX
quote: Alan Wake 2 is not just a game, it’s an experience.**I honestly don’t know how to describe this game without making it sound exaggerated. The atmosphere, the visuals, the music, the storytelling, the characters, the horror — everything feels so carefully crafted.What I love most is that it isn’t afraid to be different. It takes its time, gets weird, gets experimental, and somehow makes all of it work. The way the story keeps playing with reality and fiction is something I rarely see in **** visuals are absolutely insane, but the graphics are not even the main reason this game stands out. It’s the **atmosphere and storytelling** that really stay with you.Some games are fun while you're playing them and then you forget about them. Alan Wake 2 is the kind of game that keeps living in your head after you turn it off.**Not perfect, but absolutely unforgettable. A masterpiece in its own way.

author: SummitVFX
quote:
80? Seriously? 
 Critics may rate it 80, but honestly, *Alan Wake* is one of those games that feels like **far more than a number on a review **** atmosphere, the storytelling, the darkness of Bright Falls, the music, the mystery, the psychological tension — everything comes together to create an experience that stays with you long after you finish it.Maybe critics are looking at the game through a scorecard, but **this is not just a game you “play” — it’s a story you experience.**If you're expecting a modern action game, you might not understand what makes *Alan Wake* special.**Trust me — give it time, immerse yourself in the story, turn the lights off, put on your headphones, and experience Bright Falls yourself.****Critics can give it a number. You decide what it means to you.

author: SummitVFX
quote: Hearts of Stone is such a good example of how to make an expansion properly. The story is darker, the characters are memorable, and some of the moments genuinely stayed with me long after finishing it.Olgierd and Gaunter O’Dimm are especially great, and the whole story feels surprisingly deep for something that was released as ****’s short compared to the main game, but the quality is ridiculously high. Absolutely worth playing
game_title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone

author: SummitVFX
quote: Blood and Wine is basically a whole new Witcher game disguised as an expansion. Toussaint is beautiful, the story is amazing, the characters are great, and the atmosphere is completely different from the main game.What I love most is how much care went into it. It actually feels like a proper conclusion to Geralt’s journey rather than just extra **** of the best expansions I’ve ever played. Huge respect to CDPR
game_title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine

author: SummitVFX
quote: The Witcher 3 Complete Edition is honestly one of those games that makes you forget how old it is. The world feels alive, the characters are incredibly well written, and there is just so much to discover everywhere you go.Having the full game with Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine in one package is an insane amount of content. I’ve played it multiple times and I still find new things every time.Still one of my favorite RPGs ever. CDPR absolutely nailed this one️
game_title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition

author: SummitVFX
quote: Honestly, The Witcher 3 is still one of the greatest games I’ve ever played. The world, story, characters and the amount of care put into every little detail are just **** now we’re getting another next-gen upgrade and a free remastered upgrade for existing owners. Huge respect to CDPR for continuing to support a game this old instead of just moving on and forgetting it.Thank you, CDPR. You can really feel the love behind your games. ️
